verdict.rationale: AvaTax is a SaaS tax API with an official MCP server, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents API keys, permission scopes, role-limited credentials, or per-agent access controls. The only related item is a generic mention that API Explorer lists 'authentication requirements', which is not evidence of scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
